status: No blocker for the current unintegrated read-only structural support scope
scope: Independent source and contract review; selected fixture review and complete author-manifest hash validation. No independent rederivation of every new ASM claim, no new native call and no live process access.
findings: Snapshot buffers own bounded host-heap storage. CaptureStable requires two distinct snapshots and compares complete copied graph, parameter, task and history data. Both validity flags are cleared on mismatch or failure.
Capture.valid only describes one locally consistent observation. The contract explicitly excludes atomicity, unobserved address/content ABA and a grant to call native Undo/Redo.

Complete list bounds/tails, reciprocal sorted tasks, part membership, disjoint spans, per-layer anchor/root/index relations and six-neighbor coverage connectivity are checked. The code prevents a ghost/deleted part from being treated as a placed owner.
Phase1 permits the native hidden cursor to retain obsolete selections; phase6 checks settled supported tools and exact helper tasks. Help reads BYTE+9072, matching the documented field width.
History removal records bind to current owner ID and unique layer/anchor. The implementation does not incorrectly require every historical addition record to describe today's owners.
Source contains no native Undo/Redo call, public handler, command or capability. TrainerBridge does not include this file; slots439..446 remain unadvertised in the integrated tests.

The explicit remaining resource, allocator, placement arithmetic, cost/HUD and post-History refresh obligations are justified. This review does not promote the structural foundation into an executable History action.
